here is my story with coronavirus especially for young people who think this virus is not dangerous my symptoms began on wednesday th march in the evening around pm it began with a dry cough and a mild tight chest i did not think much of it i just thought it was a typical cough and that it was nothing to worry about i cancelled all my classes private client s for the next morning with extreme pracaution now in these situations it is very easy to freak out and become extremely paranoid and start to believe you have other symptoms it is important to take deep breaths and be present in the moment i kept calm and kept telling myself i am fit and health and this is just mild i am fit and healthy and my body can fight this off i began to feel better saturday afternoon evening until am on sunday march i suddenly became very hot cold and feverish my body began to shake and my fever shot through the roof my body went into some kind of shock and i threw up blood i then began to realise this was not a joke it was serious and i needed to call for help my breathing started to become an issue and my chest felt like someone was squeezing and blocking my airways i called and i was directed to the online page i had to fill out a questionnaire and the result was a red page that said call immediately which i freaked out and was so scared i called and was crying and shaking they were incredible and stayed on the phone with my whilst they arranged an ambulance they apologised and said the wait was an hour and a half because there was a huge demand with the virus i had to book an uber and notify the driver of the situation to which he was also incredible and could not have got me there any quicker when i arrived i was greeted by two nurses who were fully protected head to toe they handed me a face mask and kept their distance another sick lady was next to me with their partner who was made to wait outside of the hospital we both had to go in to the waiting area on our own we were the only two in the waiting area continued in comments
